fieldTools.newTab: Opens in the map app or a new tab

scanner.title: Scan
scanner.intro: Scan the equipment QR code, or enter an equipment ID, work order reference or order number.
scanner.scanning: Point the camera at the QR code …
scanner.unsupported: This browser cannot scan with the camera. Enter the code manually below.
scanner.insecure: Camera scanning requires a secure connection (HTTPS). Open the app over https://, or enter the code manually below.
scanner.denied: Camera access is blocked. Allow it in the browser settings, or enter the code manually.
scanner.unavailable: No camera was found. Enter the code manually below.
scanner.overconstrained: The camera does not support the selected setting. Close other apps that use the camera and try again, or enter the code manually.
scanner.busy: The camera is busy or unavailable. Close other apps that use the camera and try again, or enter the code manually.
scanner.decode: The camera works, but the code could not be read. Hold it steadier and make sure there is enough light, or enter it manually.
scanner.loaderError: The scanner could not be loaded. Check your network connection and try again, or enter the code manually.
scanner.error: Could not read the code. Try again, or enter it manually.
scanner.duplicate: This code has already been read. Hold it steady, or try another code.
scanner.manualPlaceholder: For example O-261103-ABCD1234 or an equipment ID
scanner.manualHint: You can also paste the full link from the QR label.

errors.invalid: The code is not a valid equipment or work order reference.
errors.notFound: No equipment or work order matches this code. Check the label, or ask the office.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to what this code points to.

serviceWorker.updateReady: A new version of the field app is ready.
